card.name: Verbs right before an adverb slot
card.fires_on: A verb or auxiliary such as is, are, fails or change that follows a subject, at a point where an adverb like 'previously' or 'recently' could come next. Mostly in general web prose, not drug labels.

modes.label: Is/are after a subject
modes.description: A form of 'be' right after a long noun phrase subject.
modes.example: United States congressional apportionment United States congressional apportionment is the process by which seats in the United States House of Representatives<< are>> redistributed amongst the 50 states following

modes.label: Other verbs or adverbs
modes.description: A main verb or adverb such as change, fails or now before the rest of the clause.
modes.example: (To help fight spam, this address might<< change>> occasionally.)

card.writes: It pushes the model toward time adverbs such as previously, recently, originally and earlier.
card.plain: It fires on a verb in the middle of a sentence, where a word like 'previously' or 'recently' could fit.
